description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {2}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens, two Food tokens, two Clue tokens and two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Foods, two Clues and two Treasures by tapping them, adding {3}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
